Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my enthusiastic interest in the Demand Generation Marketeer position at SOFICO, as advertised. Your commitment to shaping the future of mobility with Miles deeply resonates with my passion for driving growth in the tech sector.

My experience as a Digital Marketer and Web & SEO Specialist, particularly in B2B contexts, aligns well with your focus on generating qualified leads and executing multi-channel campaigns. Sincerely,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am writing to express my keen interest in the Demand Generation Marketeer position at SOFICO. The opportunity to contribute to a team that is innovating the future of mobility with the Miles platform, and doing so with a focus on collaboration and growth, truly excites me.

My background in digital marketing and web optimization, developed through roles at Episto and Knowledge Experts, directly aligns with your need for a professional who can develop and execute multi-channel demand generation campaigns. At Episto, I managed on-page SEO, keyword research, and content for B2B client websites, consistently tracking results with analytics tools to drive organic traffic. This experience has equipped me with a strong foundation in creating content and optimizing web presence that measurably supports lead generation.

I possess a robust understanding of analytics, evidenced by my proficiency in Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Semrush, and Ahrefs. My work has involved conducting iterative technical SEO audits and reporting on performance to inform data-driven optimizations. Furthermore, my HubSpot Academy Content Marketing Certification demonstrates my familiarity with marketing automation principles and tools, which is crucial for managing content and email campaigns effectively. My experience with enterprise clients at Knowledge Experts also provides insight into strategic account engagement.

Fluent in English, I thrive in fast-paced technological environments and am adept at managing web content through platforms like WordPress. My analytical mindset, combined with a commitment to achieving measurable results, makes me confident in my ability to support SOFICO’s pipeline growth and enhance brand awareness in the automotive software market. I am eager to apply my mix of marketing and technical skills to your innovative team.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to SOFICO's continued success.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
cv_highlights:
- Proven experience in digital marketing, covering SEO, content, and web optimization for B2B clients, driving organic traffic and lead generation.
- Skilled in developing and executing multi-channel digital strategies, including content management, website optimization, and performance tracking.
- Proficient with a range of analytics tools (Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs) to track campaign performance and inform data-driven optimization.
- Certified in HubSpot Content Marketing, demonstrating familiarity with marketing automation platforms and engagement with enterprise clients.
- Fluent in English, comfortable in fast-paced tech environments, with additional language skills in Dutch.
